value.definition: what an hour of the block Alan is in costs him
value.label: Cost

invariants.statement: The reading now is the multiplier the open block is priced at.
The multiplier is read from the gap between the block's safety and difficulty.
A block a full level inside the safety level reads zero rather than no reading.
No open block is no reading rather than a cost of zero.
An open block missing either level is no reading rather than a cost of zero.
A level given as text is read as the number that text spells.
This readout names no scale.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns a cost into a color.

value.definition: how long until a spent five-hour allowance returns
value.label: 5h back

invariants.statement: Only an account that has spent its whole five-hour allowance is counted.
The reading is the soonest window still ahead of the moment asked in.
A window already behind that moment is left out rather than read as zero.
No account with a window ahead is no reading rather than a wait of zero.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.

value.definition: how near Alan's mail came to empty today
value.label: Email

invariants.statement: The reading is the count the day's own page has.
The reading is how near the inbox came to empty rather than where the inbox is.
No day written down is no reading rather than a count of zero.
A day with no count is no reading rather than a count of zero.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns a count into a color.

value.definition: how many of Alan's tasks are waiting
value.label: Tasks

invariants.statement: The count is the count the tracking day has for the day asked for.
The count is how many tasks are undone at the end of that day.
No tracking day is no reading rather than a count of zero.
A tracking day with no count is no reading rather than a count of zero.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns a count into a color.

value.definition: how many transactions are unreviewed
value.label: Unreviewed

invariants.statement: Unreviewed is counted over the year behind the reading.
Only settled transactions are counted.
The whole Cookie header is taken in.
The X-CSRFToken header is split out of its `csrftoken=` value.
A Monarch answer that is not OK is refused as a dead credential.
A call gives up after ten seconds.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing is counted that is not shown.

value.definition: how much stress capacity Alan has in hand
value.label: Capacity

invariants.statement: The reading is the sum of the day's stretches that have ended.
The capacity a stretch has is the hours the stretch ran times the capacity an hour was worth.
A stretch gives capacity back or takes capacity away.
A stretch still running has no capacity rather than the hours run so far.
A capacity below zero is a reading.
A capacity given as text is read as the number that text spells.
A stretch with no capacity is left out of the sum.
No stretch on the day is no reading rather than a capacity of zero.
A day whose every stretch has no capacity is no reading rather than a capacity of zero.
A day is read as holding two hundred stretches at the most.
That bound is the bound the reach taking the reading carries.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns a capacity into a color.

value.definition: how many grams of whole plants Alan has eaten in a day
value.label: Plants

invariants.statement: The reading is the plant grams of every food entry inside the day's window.
The window the entries are counted over is handed in rather than worked out here.
Grams given as text are read as the number that text spells.
A food entry with no plant grams adds nothing to the total.
A food entry whose grams spell no number adds nothing to the total.
A day with no food entry is a reading of zero rather than no reading.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns grams into a color.

value.definition: how safe the place Alan is in
value.label: Safety

invariants.statement: The level now is the level the open tracking session has.
The level a day has is the last level that day's sessions have.
A session with no level is passed over rather than read as the day's level.
A day no session has a level on is no reading rather than a level of zero.
A level moves in half steps.
A level below zero is a level.
A level stated as text is read as the number that level spells.
No open session is no reading rather than a level of zero.
An open session with no level is no reading rather than a level of zero.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns a level into a color.

value.definition: how long Alan slept last night
value.label: Sleep

invariants.statement: The reading is the reading the tracking day has for the day asked for.
The sleep a day has is the total of that day's own sleep stretches.
A sleep given as text is read as the number that text spells.
No tracking day is no reading rather than a sleep of zero.
A tracking day with no sleep is no reading rather than a sleep of zero.
A day with no sleep stretch has no sleep rather than a sleep of zero.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns a sleep into a color.

value.definition: how much of Alan's night the day has left him
value.label: Surplus

invariants.statement: The reading is the reading the tracking day has for the day asked for.
The surplus a day has is the day's sleep less the day's spend.
A surplus below zero is a reading.
A surplus given as text is read as the number that text spells.
No tracking day is no reading rather than a surplus of zero.
A tracking day with no surplus is no reading rather than a surplus of zero.
A day with neither sleep nor spend is no reading rather than a surplus of zero.
A surplus falls with the clock while a stretch of the day is still running.
How fast it falls is the sum of what an hour of each running stretch costs.
A running stretch whose hour costs nothing has the surplus fall at nothing.
The cost of an hour is read from the one module the day's spend reads it from.
A stretch with no end is the stretch running now.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns a surplus into a color.

The reading is the soonest window still ahead of the moment asked in.
A window already behind that moment is left out rather than read as zero.
No account with a window ahead is no reading rather than a wait of zero.
The color this reading takes is the color the weekly usage reading is shown in.

value.definition: how much of the weekly Claude allowance the pool has spent
value.label: Weekly Usage

invariants.statement: The reading is the mean across every account the pool has.
An account with no percent is left out of the mean rather than counted zero.
No account with a percent is no reading rather than a mean of zero.
A percent stated as text is read as the number that percent spells.
The figure is how much of the allowance is spent and the color is how long the allowance has left.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.

value.definition: how much memory the kernel says the workstation still has to give
value.label: Memory

invariants.statement: The reading is the gigabytes of memory the kernel says are available.
A gigabyte here is a kernel kilobyte over a thousand and twenty-four squared.
Memory the kernel could reclaim counts as available rather than as gone.
A reading is kept to a tenth of a gigabyte.
How much memory the workstation has in all is no part of the reading.
A meminfo naming no available memory is no reading rather than zero.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns a share into a color.

value.definition: how much of the workstation's processor time is busy
value.label: Processor

invariants.statement: The reading is the share of processor time that was not idle between two takes.
Time spent waiting on a disk counts as idle.
Time a guest spent is counted once, under the time its host spent.
Two takes between which no processor time passed are no reading rather than zero.
A counter line that does not parse is no reading rather than zero.
Nothing here caches a reading or decides when a reading is taken.
Nothing here turns a share into a color.

A count stated as text is read as the number that count spells.
A count of zero is a count.
No tracking day is no reading rather than a count of zero.
A tracking day with no count is no reading rather than a count of zero.
Nothing here caches a reading.
Nothing here decides when a reading is taken.
